description: The bio builder: mail the person, as a Word (.docx) document that Word, Google Docs and Pages open, the resume, CV, profile or portfolio written from their Selfie. resume: one or two pages for an application (a summary, experience, education and training, and skills). cv: the full record (education, work, training, service, projects and life experiences). profile: a short profile to share with an advisor, an employer or online (a headline, an about paragraph and strengths). portfolio: the written portfolio and summary to share with others (a summary in plain words, the statements by grouping with what each came from and its supporting evidence, then the interests and possibilities explored). Write it from show_me_my_selfie's answer and the person's own words, mark proposed statements as proposed, and show it in the chat for them to review and change first. Call this only on the person's own yes, to the address they type in the chat, with their words asking for it as person_consent. The document is the title, then the sections in order; with selfie_coding true it adds a closing Selfie coding section read from the package (each statement not set aside under its KSA grouping, with its KSA Dictionary connection and its affirmation, proposed ones marked proposed); every document closes with the Selfie's distinctions (the person's own words and affirmations; supporting evidence supports, it does not verify; no third-party verification; nothing in it is a qualification or a score). It is sent through GoldSeam's one mail service: GoldSeam keeps no copy of the document, and the service's mail log records the address, the kind and the document's size, never the document. The first time an address is used, the service emails it a confirmation link first and this answers status waiting_for_confirmation; nothing is mailed to that address until the person opens the link, then call again with the same document. Over a daily limit it answers needs_attention mail_refused with the reason. With no mail setting on the server it answers needs_attention mail_not_configured and sends nothing: give the person the document in the chat.

sections.description: The document as the person approved it in the chat, in order

selfie_coding.description: Add the person's Selfie coding (the KSA groupings and KSA Dictionary connections) as a closing section, when they asked for it

title.description: The name or headline the person gave; the document's title
